title: SimpleDiagrams document format 18: manifest.json
description: The manifest of a SimpleDiagrams document package in document format 18. It names the format and its version so a reader can decide how to read the rest of the package before reading it. The app ignores keys it does not know here and drops them when it next saves; a writer must not add any. The whole file is at most 65,536 bytes, which this schema cannot check. Whether contains_legacy_source agrees with the presence of legacy/source.sdxml is a package rule this schema cannot check either.

format.description: Identifies the file as a SimpleDiagrams document. Any other value is refused. This key and format_version keep their names and meaning in every document format.

format_version.description: The document format version. This schema describes document format 18. The schema_version in document.json must be one less (17).

contains_legacy_source.description: True only for a document converted from an old .sdxml file, whose original is kept as legacy/source.sdxml in the package. A newly written document has false, and then the package must not contain a legacy folder.
